description.zh:
结束时间的时间戳，精确到毫秒（ms）。
><notice>该字段类型为 Long，在序列化/反序列化的过程中可能导致精度丢失，请注意数值不得大于 9007199254740991。</notice>
description.en:
The end timestamp, in milliseconds (ms).

><notice>

The data type of this parameter is Long. Precision may be lost during serialization and deserialization. Make sure that the value does not exceed 9007199254740991.

></notice>

description.zh: 服务名称，又称为应用名称。
description.en: The service name, also known as the application name.
The span name, also known as the operation name.
